title: Estée Lauder Companies outlines 2030 growth plans in ‘next chapter’ after Beauty Reimagined turnaround
summary: Estée Lauder Companies CEO Stéphane de La Faverie has said the MAC Cosmetics and The Ordinary owner aims to deliver mid-single-digit organic sales growth annually over the next four years
